text_block_list.text:
—Summer training camp has finally reached 
its last day.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Excelente! It was a wonderful training 
camp, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
My training was thoroughly fulfilling, but 
above all, a grand mystery has been 
solved!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Why does El yearn to be the world's 
strongest? What does she see beyond that!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Because I've come to understand that 
clearly, yes!

I want to become the world's strongest to 
bring joy to everyone.

It was on that day of the summer festival 
that El Condor Pasa realized it.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And so, what begins this autumn is more 
than just a championship road aimed at 
becoming the world's strongest.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's a grand entertainment show where we 
compete with lots of friends and hype up 
all the fans, YES!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El will shine among them! Stronger and 
brighter than anyone else, like a sun 
illuminating everyone!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"...In that case, simply running and 
winning just won't cut it, yes?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Isn't there some way to hype this up even 
more...?

El Condor Pasa lost in thought. While 
aiming for victory, what else could make 
this autumn even more fulfilling...?
choice_data_list:
Shall we try holding an event or 
something?
Want to try holding an event or something?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¿Qué? An event... you say?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: An event... an event...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, I see! It's true that we can hype 
things up outside of races too!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume rival talks, handshake events, 
and a non-winning live concert!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If only we could hold such an especial 
event...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's muy bueno, Trainer! Things are 
getting super exciting now!

The summer fireworks have fallen silent. 
Yet still, the festive music of a new 
autumn festival can be heard.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's head back to Tracen Academy. 
Before the Japan Cup, first comes a 
massive carnaval!
